resources.string: Open apps in movable windows and keep them within reach

Flyme mode keeps the original small-window gestures and appearance. HyperOS mode supports multiple independent windows with its own controls and gestures. Switching modes returns current windows to full screen and keeps your app exceptions and other preferences.

Open an app menu in recent apps and choose Small window. You can keep multiple windows open. Drag the top three-dot handle to move a window; drag it to the top of the screen to preview full screen, then release to confirm or pull back to cancel. Tap the handle for window controls. Drag either bottom corner to resize; shrink far enough to minimize. Swipe up on the bottom center handle to close, or pull it down to preview full screen and release to confirm. Tap a minimized preview to restore it. When edge docking is enabled, drag a preview beyond the screen edge to tuck it into an app icon tab; tap the tab to bring it back. Switching modes or turning small windows off restores existing windows to full screen.
Show Small window in the recent app menu
Selected apps always open full screen, including from recent apps and notifications. An existing small window returns to full screen when its app is selected.
Tap a supported notification to open its app in a small window after unlocking
Selected apps open normally from notifications. Their recent apps shortcut remains available unless they are also set to always open full screen.
Size defaults apply to newly created windows. Existing windows keep their current size.
Drag a minimized preview toward either screen edge to tuck it away; tap the edge tab to restore it
Keep edge-docked windows in the foreground
Keep apps active while tucked against the edge. When off, tucked apps move to the background and videos or games may pause. Tap the edge tab to restore.
Vibrate at gesture thresholds when system touch vibration is enabled
Reset small-window options and clear app exceptions

Restore small-window defaults and clear both app exception lists? Flyme mode will be selected. Small windows and the recent apps shortcut will be enabled, and edge-docked windows will stay in the foreground. Notification dragging and opening from notifications will be disabled. The swipe-up gesture in Home screen settings is kept.

Open the recent apps screen, tap an app menu and choose Small window. Hold the window handle, then drag to move. Drag the handle directly to resize; shrink past the vibration to minimize, or enlarge past it to go full screen. Drag a preview to move it, tap to return, double tap for full screen, or hold for app mute and size controls. Muting lasts while the app stays in a small window. Drag the preview to the bottom close area to dismiss it. Turning this feature off restores windows to full screen. For apps that display incorrectly, use Always open full screen.
Swipe up for split screen or small window
Swipe up from an app, then drag toward the left target for split screen or the right target for a small window. Release to confirm or drag back to cancel. No pause in overview is needed.
Pull down a notification to a small window
Show a bottom handle on eligible notifications. Pull down and release to open an interactive small window; drag back to cancel.
